title: Treaty of Constantinople (1897)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Constantinople (1897)", at revision 1353535518, opens: "The Treaty of Constantinople was a treaty between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Greece signed on 4 December 1897 following the Greco-Turkish War (1897)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q495833, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1897 treaty between the Ottoman Empire and Greece". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
